application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

chemistry.source: scripts/facts/_extra.py chemistry rule: 99th percentile of released cell voltage (<3.70 V LFP, >3.95 V NMC-class)
chemistry.note: Snippet maximum cell voltage, 99th percentile per archive: battery_brand1.tar.gz 4.121 V, battery_brand2.tar.gz 4.301 V, battery_brand3.tar.gz 4.224 V.

units_released.note: Rule: labeled vehicles with at least one snippet. Vehicles with at least one snippet; the label tables list 348 cars, and battery_brand2.tar.gz car 230 has no snippets.

cells_liion.note: Released snippets do not provide a physical pack-topology field.

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.note: Snippets carry only the maximum and minimum cell voltage, not individual cells.

energy_mwh.note: The release does not provide a complete nominal pack-energy rating or configuration from which to compute one.

span_unit_years.note: Released snippets have relative sample positions but no calendar timestamps.

obs_hours.note: Lower bound: union of snippet time ranges per vehicle and charge segment. In brand 3 snippet clocks run through the segment, so the union is exact; in brands 1 and 2 each snippet's clock restarts at zero, so overlapping snippets count once per segment. The plain sum of snippet durations is 249,096 h, an upper bound.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.23659323; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
